name: Bases Descendant Filter
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Adds a Bases descendant view with multi-parent traversal, cycle handling, and Pro route explanations.
changes_user: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Settings now end with a More from NoteMods group, where you can turn this tab off or open it again.
tip: Intermediate notes can stay outside the Bases query. The view still reads their parent links to connect the root to your notes.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Bases Descendant Filter is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it with Bases. Bases is still new, and your setups teach me a lot.

related.name: Bases Filter Switches
related.blurb: Turn saved Bases filters on or off with switches.

related.blurb: See the notes and links from a filtered base as a graph.

related.blurb: Keep column and note names visible as you scroll a base.
